commits.message:
feat: add discarded_storage_read lint for unused storage gets

Detects get() calls on Instance/Persistent/Temporary storage whose
result is discarded (statement expression) or bound to wildcard (_).

Does not fire on has() checks or reads used in subsequent expressions.
Suggests has() as a cheaper alternative for existence checks.

Covers #116.
fix: collapse if and fmt check_get_discarded signature
